direct_plan.plan_text:
1. **Assess Position & Direction**: Identify snake's head position, current direction (arrow), and food location. Prioritize avoiding walls and body collisions.  
2. **Prioritize Food**: Move toward nearest food; if food is adjacent, eat it (grows snake, resets tail).  
3. **Avoid Collisions**: If head is about to hit wall or body, reverse direction (left/right turn) to escape.  
4. **Maintain Space**: Keep body segments spaced to allow movement; avoid tight loops.  
5. **Adapt to Growth**: After eating, reposition tail to create new space;

limitations: Performance differences include APC, compilation, CUDA graphs, scheduler defaults and memory budget together.
Scoring wall time uses the same synchronous backend.generate boundary in all runs; a yes/no score includes its candidate batch.
Requests within a score have no independent latency measurement. Cache hit/miss latency groups classify whole scores and have different input mixes.
Formal request order is fixed. Cache is reset before each plan and retained across formal scores within each model/seed worker.
no_plan uses matching prompts; shared conditions can have different independently generated plans. Fixed-plan diagnostics cover eight readout fixtures/model, order zero only.
48 screenshots are 12 base cases with four rotations; seeds partition fixtures and are not independent randomized repetitions.
Historical per-phase startup timings are unavailable where absent in receipts; platform time includes initialization and teardown. Cold compilation cache is isolated per new worker.
BF16 numerical changes can affect argmax and generated plans; higher allowed-answer probability does not establish better task accuracy.
